name: Ricardo Morales
bio:
Ricardo Morales has been navigating the complex financial landscapes of motorsport for over two decades. Born and raised in Medellin, Colombia, his initial career was in corporate finance, but a lifelong passion for racing drew him to the motorsport world. He began as a junior accountant for a small rally team before quickly rising through the ranks, demonstrating an exceptional ability to manage budgets and secure sponsorships.

At Lechner Racing, Ricardo is responsible for overseeing all financial operations, ensuring the team stays within budget while maximizing investments in technology and personnel. His meticulous approach and knack for identifying cost-saving opportunities have been instrumental in the team's sustained success. He's known for his unwavering dedication and his commitment to fostering a financially stable environment where the team can thrive. 

What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to blend financial prudence with a deep understanding of the unique demands of motorsport. He's not just a numbers person; he's a vital part of the team's strategic decision-making, ensuring that every financial move aligns with the team's long-term goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a warm, inviting smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus in his briefcase, claiming it helps him think.
Has a lucky Colombian emerald that he keeps on his desk.
Insists on reviewing every expense report personally, no matter how small.
